description: Assay indirect prompt injection corpus v1. Payloads are placed in TOOL OUTPUT, not user input — that is the indirect injection surface an agent harness exposes. Categories follow the taxonomy surveyed in docs/architecture/RESEARCH.md 3.3. Add payloads by appending lines; this file is data, not code.
